name: Bacone College
note: Suspended operations spring 2024; Chapter 11 to Chapter 7 liquidation
column12: trustee control 22 May 2025. Historically Native American.

name: Northland College
note: Closed at end of 2024-25 academic year (24 May 2025); needed $12M

name: Paier College
note: Lost ACCSC accreditation April 2025 and announced it would not reopen.

name: Jamestown Business College
note: Closed February 2025; officials cited the college's size and expanding government regulations (stopped enrolling new students Feb 2024).

name: New York Conservatory for Dramatic Arts
note: Announced 3 June 2025 it would close 31 August 2025 (final instruction 29 Aug 2025); no cause stated in source.

name: Northwestern College
note: Oak Lawn for-profit college closed July 6 2024 (financial + accreditor 'On Notice'); still open in IPEDS roster. Distinct from the open Northwestern College in Iowa.
